items.title: 68089_John Malachi oral history interview
items.q: a guy who had him in Washington, who I understand had kind of come up with Rex Stewart

ctx.x: Roy Eldridge...one of the more famous types of things that happened like that was with him. And a guy who had him

in Washington, who I understand had kind of come up with Rex Stewart... His name was Danny Bashears(?), and everybody called him "Georgetown." Georgetown, like James Morgan who I mentioned earlier, was a trumpet player that never left Washington, D.C. But he played as good as anybody in the country, including... I understand... I didn't hear the battle that they had, but I understand that Roy Eldridge came in town, and he and Georgetown had it, and it was 50-50 as to who was playing what. I later heard…
But all that was quite a learning experience to me in hearing these people play.
